description: Department of Wildlife Conservation - Declare that Sanctuary known as the Narangala Santuary
categorisation: This gazette content involves the Minister of Wildlife and Forest Resources Conservation exercising powers under the Fauna and Flora Protection Ordinance to declare a specific land area as a protected sanctuary. This constitutes a regulatory action under existing legislation, making it a Legal/Regulatory Gazette (Type 5) rather than a government personnel or structural announcement. The content focuses on establishing a legal framework for wildlife protection rather than government organizational changes or personnel appointments.
